annotations.title: Starting a sole proprietorship in Poland: steps, ZUS and VAT for 3 years

description: Use when someone in Poland wants to start a sole proprietorship (jak założyć działalność, założenie firmy w CEIDG): steps and deadlines, ZUS stages with monthly amounts for the first 3 years, VAT and cash register. For a person from abroad use plan_business_entry. Give the inputs and the assumptions with the result. The result is a calculation from statutory rates. It is not advice. Give the legal basis and the verification date of each fact. Plan for starting a Polish sole proprietorship (JDG, jednoosobowa działalność gospodarcza) and its first 3 years: CEIDG application (free, business may start on the filing day), NIP and REGON forwarded by CEIDG no later than the next working day, ZUS registration within 7 days (health insurance only during the start relief), VAT registration before the first sale when expected sales exceed the exemption limit pro rata to the days of business in the start year, business account rules, cash register when sales to private persons exceed the limit (pro rata in the start year, exemption lapses 2 months after the month of exceeding), then the ZUS stages: start relief (ulga na start) 6 months without social contributions, preferential ZUS 24 months from 30% of the minimum wage (a start in the middle of a month counts from the next month), small ZUS plus (mały ZUS plus) from half of the previous-year income when the previous-year revenue is within the limit, or full ZUS. Monthly social and health contributions for every stage and year use the contribution bases of that year; years without announced bases are marked as estimates. Facts carry the act, article, link and verification date.

annual_costs.description: Yearly costs PLN (tax scale, flat tax), for the health contribution and the small ZUS plus income.

annual_revenue.description: Expected yearly revenue without VAT, PLN.

consumer_sales.description: Yearly sales to private persons PLN, for the cash register limit. Default 0.

eligible_for_reliefs.description: First business, or at least 60 months since the last one, and not working for a former employer. false = full ZUS from the start. Default true.

start_relief.description: Use the 6-month start relief (ulga na start). Default true.

tax.description: Income tax form: tax scale, flat 19%, lump sum on revenue. Default scale.
